verdict.rationale: Luma's own marketing says its Agents "generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text" in the same workspace, so the product claims audio generation in the same tool. Nothing shows what kind of audio (sound effects, ambience or music) or that it is matched to the generated scene. missing for 10: documented sound-effect/ambient/music generation, scene-matched or video-synced audio, audio controls or API parameters, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text
Browser-based creative workspace; Luma Agents for multi-step video and image workflows
